business_summary: KEL Corporation engages in the manufacture and sale of connectors, racks, and other products in Japan, China, Other Asia, Europe, and the United States. It offers board to board, board to cable, and socket and battery connectors; and rack products for use in camera/video, factory automation/equipment, automobile, medical/healthcare, infrastructure/railway, and amusement related applications. The company is also involved in the harness business. KEL Corporation was incorporated in 1962 and is based in Tama, Japan.
